title: Cache error-handling test accepts both pass and fail behavior
reasoning: The test named for graceful cache error handling catches and suppresses exceptions from both cache get and cache set, then performs no assertion about the result. That means the test passes whether AnalyticsCacheService handles cache failures gracefully or raises, so it cannot protect the intended resilience behavior.
recommendation: Decide the contract for AnalyticsCacheService cache failures and assert it directly. If graceful degradation is intended, assert get returns None and set returns without raising when cache operations fail.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: This is the existing test, but it explicitly treats raised exceptions as acceptable, so it does not fail on the behavior it claims to cover.
suggestedRegressionTest: Patch cache.get and cache.set to raise, call AnalyticsCacheService.get_daily_aggregates/set_daily_aggregates without try/except, and assert the expected fallback result/no exception.
minimumFixScope: Update test_cache_service_error_handling to enforce one behavior instead of accepting both.
